name: eternauta-online
description: El Eternauta Online — prototipo jugable en Three.js + Gaussian splatting (Spark)

scripts.collider:base: node scripts/prepare-collider.mjs 'assets-src/Nevada en Plaza de Mayo_collider.glb' assets-src/collider_base.glb
scripts.collider:export: ${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender} -b assets-src/colisiones.blend --python scripts/blender/headless.py -- export && rm -f assets-src/colisiones.blend1 && npm run collider:publish
scripts.collider:rebuild: ${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender} -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/headless.py -- setup && rm -f assets-src/colisiones.blend1 && npm run collider:publish
